id: title:Radu-Raicea:toggle signal sources from the self driving tab

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend UI and test coverage for the AI observability signal source toggle and its associated API interactions.
review.reason: The chunk adds a new UI component, its Storybook stories, and snapshot tests, along with mock API responses and a fallback state. This is a localized, bounded implementation and test addition. No systemic risk reduction or broader capability change is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the signalSourcesLogic implementation or the actual JSX implementation of the toggle, so the reviewer cannot assess the implementation and validation of the signalSourcesLogic, the signalSourcesType, or the signalSourcesLogic. This limits the assessment to the added tests and the fallback state, not the full behavior of the feature.
